---
name: first-issue-pack
description: Create implementation-ready starter issues for VenturaSec from the approved defensive MVP and Beta gates. Use when maintainers need small independent tasks that move the scaffold toward a reproducible prototype. Do not use when requirements are undefined or the issue would introduce offensive capabilities.
---

# First issue pack

- Read the current defensive scope and repository state first.
- Create one verifiable outcome per issue.
- Include dataset provenance metric and false-positive acceptance criteria when relevant.
- Separate ingestion detection evaluation tests and documentation work when independent.
- Keep each issue suitable for one focused pull request.
- Exclude exploitation malware evasion and attack automation tasks.
